articles.title: Scientists Find the 'Chunkiest' Ancient Squid Relative
articles.summary: Wyoming fossils show a new 160-million-year-old squid relative that is the chunkiest of its kind ever found.

articles.title: A Healthy Twin Helps Sick Coral Get Better
articles.summary: In lab tests, bleached corals got healthy in seven weeks after touching identical healthy coral pieces.

articles.title: Tiny Cracks Help Solve a Mystery on Asteroid Bennu
articles.summary: Rocks brought back from asteroid Bennu are full of tiny cracks, helping explain why its rocky surface cools so fast.
